traits.name: Fearless
traits.summary: Gain +2 on saving throws against fear.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.summary: Gain sling proficiency and treat halfling weapons as martial.

alternateTraits.name: Craven
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 initiative and flanking attacks, but take penalties against fear; fear also increases speed and AC.

alternateTraits.name: Low Blow
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 on critical confirmation rolls against larger opponents.

alternateTraits.name: Practicality
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on one Craft or Profession skill, Sense Motive, and saves against illusions.

alternateTraits.name: Swift as Shadows
alternateTraits.summary: Reduce the Stealth penalty while moving by 5 and the sniping penalty by 10.

alternateTraits.name: Underfoot
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 dodge AC against larger foes and +1 Reflex against trample.

alternateTraits.name: Wanderlust
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 Knowledge (geography) and Survival and count caster level as one higher for movement effects.

alternateTraits.name: Warslinger
alternateTraits.summary: Reload a sling as a free action while using two hands and provoking normally.
